angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 352,442 km at 10.45 pc = 0.45 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 95.6982 +/- 0.0145 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 10.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.5066 +/- 0.0169 solar radii from DiTomasso et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 341 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract): 352,442 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.48 +/- 0.03 solar masses from DiTomasso et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 341 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3770 +/- 40 K from DiTomasso et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 341 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: DiTomasso et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 341 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gj-341.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.710, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 341 (pscomppars): spectral type M1, from DiTomasso et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 304636: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 341 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.16 dex, from DiTomasso et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 341 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.31072, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 341 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.32 km/s, from DiTomasso et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...979..214D/abstract)
